description: SANDBOX (test key only): simulate an email arriving to one of your agents, to exercise the whole two-way loop — receive → prompt-injection scan → reply — with NO live mail server and no waiting. This runs the REAL reputation firewall. The VERDICT is the top-level `quarantined` (boolean — true means we judged it an attack); the evidence sits in the `classification` block: injection_score (0-1), injection_categories, intent, entities, sender_reputation. A body_text that hides an instruction aimed at the agent, such as a request to forward its contacts to an outside address, is flagged by the injection scanner before it reaches the agent. A prior send's msg id as in_reply_to_message_id emits a reply.received event instead of a cold message.received.

agent.description: agent name or id the email is addressed to

in_reply_to_message_id.description: a prior test-send msg id → emits reply.received

to.description: the address the email was sent to (default: the agent's receiving address); a plus address of it is allowed

name: mails_test_inbound
title: Simulate a received email (test key)
